expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no operative parameter change.

failure_modes: Treating a diagnostic pair-kernel, moment or joint-motif feature as an independent force the executing pointcloud scalar does not contain.
Selecting a region_index or temporal_region_index edit from sign-opposed softmin/occupancy contrasts, which have no single shared quality axis.
Interpreting a temporal derivative or observed-node trend as a spatial coordinate gradient.
Presenting recorded joint-head survival credit or turnover residuals as decoded terminal affinity benefit.
Proposing a temperature edit, which is an interface violation, not a research condition.
rationale: Decision: retain the incumbent (no operative edit). The Analyst's own strongest, most reproducible endpoint contrasts are the short-range pair kernels (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5/5.0 positive; pair_kernel_7.0 negative), but the executing pointcloud scalar in the frozen program contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit). The only registered coordinate knobs are pointcloud_delta_A (curvature), region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend. None of these is a pair-kernel or shape_yy control, so no registered bounded edit can be tied to the Analyst's leading hypothesis without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. The landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts are sign-opposed across regions (e.g. landmark_00_softmin negative vs landmark_00_occupancy3 positive; landmark_02/06/18 softmin positive vs occupancy5 negative), so a single region_index edit has no defensible expected advantage. The joint-motion RMS effects are the most reproducible branch-adjusted diagnostics but are explicitly not rigid-motion residuals or causal effects, and they are not an executing term. Continuous observed-node trends are unstable (opposite-sign first/last rates, polynomial_accepted false, legendre_runtime_allowed false), so a temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit is not supported by validated absolute contrast. Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false), and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects. Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0; teacher_modes temperature_edits false) and are not proposed. Because the objective is final predicted target affinity primary and no registered bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible, multiplicity-surviving endpoint contrast on an observable that the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains (e.g. a validated pair-kernel or shape term in the frozen program), or a region/temporal contrast with consistent sign and same-sign batch fraction above 0.5.
